name: safari/google_search
description: Open Safari on iOS, run a Google search, and extract top organic results (mobile + desktop layouts).

query.description: What you want to search on Google.

limit.description: Maximum number of organic results to return.

captureScreenshot.description: Keep the Safari screenshot artifact in the result.

capturePageSource.description: Also return the page source for debugging or downstream parsing.

help.when_to_use: Use this when you want quick mobile Google results from a real iPhone without dropping into raw Safari tools.
help.returns: Ordered organic Google results with title, URL, snippet, and optional screenshot or page source artifacts.
